scope: Independent source WebGL, printed-scan comparisons, exact frozen compiled public UI and native Duel paths. Not a 1:1 art certificate.
limitations: The before and after views show the public Atlas camera; the new scenes intentionally adopt a printed-illustration crop and orthographic framing. They are not pixel comparisons under an identical old camera.
Faces, hair, anatomy, cloth and tiny crowd figures remain procedural and stylized.
Normalized reference points are independently inspected approximations, not a photogrammetric measurement or an image-similarity certification.
Profiles, backs and hidden surfaces of a single printed view remain inferred.
Prank-Kids background inventory is an interpretation of partially occluded tiny subjects, not a canonical count.

The source driver was expanded after the initial before capture to resolve exact per-server Vite dependency URLs and add subject isolations/compiled audits. Both recipe versions and raw reports are retained.
SwiftShader timings are not physical desktop or phone frame-rate guarantees.
